newsitem.title: FRANCE: French judge orders ETA suspects held.
newsitem.headline: French judge orders ETA suspects held.

text.p: Two suspected supporters of the Basque separatist guerrilla group ETA were placed under investigation on Saturday and ordered held in preventive custody by a French anti-terrorism judge, justice sources said.

Paris Judge Laurence Le Vert ordered Jean Etchart Erdozaincy and Didier Aguerre held after they were seized on Tuesday in a probe into two attacks against paramilitary gendarmerie barracks in the French Basque region in November and January.

Cooperation between France and Spain has led to more than 200 arrests in the past decade. ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed around 800 people since 1968 in its campaign for an independent Basque state.
